question: Should agents receive only aggregate capacity for agents they are authorized to spawn, or a privileged detailed view containing lane and session identities?
rationale: The internal backend and missing exposure are clear, but the stable public schema, privacy boundary, and advisory scheduling semantics require maintainer intent.

options.title: Authorized Aggregates
options.body: Expose advisory active, queued, maximum, and remaining capacity for spawnable agents without unrelated lane or session identities.

options.title: Privileged Detailed View
options.body: Expose identifiable lanes, agents, and sessions only through an explicitly elevated permission intended for operator-grade dispatchers.

options.title: Keep Status Local
options.body: Retain current-session status only and decline broader dispatcher introspection.

recommendation.title: Authorized Aggregates
recommendation.body: Expose advisory active, queued, maximum, and remaining capacity for spawnable agents without unrelated lane or session identities.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history spans the queue runtime, spawn semantics, status tooling, and catalog policy involved in this product choice.
